stage: 2: facility-scale offered-arrival construction, no power or queue model
mix_policy: Keep both services' observed counts on the same UTC window; 39:61 is rounded, not imposed per block
scale_policy: Apply the SAME integer multiplier to both services; preserve time and five-minute counts
